label: Agnosticism
description: Suspension of judgment; embodied by Jastrow, cited by Turek as a hostile witness for the Big Bang.

label: Anti-theism
description: Hitchens's stronger stance: relief that no celestial dictatorship exists, which he would oppose if it did.

label: Atheism
description: No advanced argument for God has survived rebuttal; not the dogmatic claim no God could exist.

label: Christianity
description: The specific tradition Turek personally holds but brackets in favor of generic theism for the debate.

label: Deism
description: A designer who set the cosmos in order but does not intervene or reveal itself; Hitchens treats it as separable from theism.

label: Humanism
description: Ethics grounded in innate solidarity, empathy, and conscience without divine sanction.

label: Materialism
description: Only matter exists; mind, reason, and morality reduce to physical processes. Closely tied to naturalism; Turek's main target.

label: Theism
description: A personal God who created and intervenes in the universe, answers prayer, and grounds morality.
